title: Bu kompaniya 1889 yilda qog'oz o'yin kartalari yasagan...
hook: Bu kompaniya ish boshlaganda karta yasagan.

scenes.text: 1889 yilda Kiotoda Fusajiro Yamauchi qo'lda yasalgan hanafuda o'yin kartalarini sota boshladi.
scenes.keywords: traditional japanese street kyoto old town

scenes.text: Kompaniya o'nlab yillar karta sotdi, keyin boshqa sohalarni ham sinab ko'rdi.
scenes.keywords: playing cards spread on wooden table

scenes.text: 1981 yilda u Donkey Kong o'yinini, 1983 yilda esa Famicom pristavkasini chiqardi.
Bu kompaniya Nintendo. U hozir ham Kiotoda va hanafuda kartalarini sotishda davom etadi.
scenes.keywords: game controller in hands close up

scenes.text: Bozor o'zgarsa, kompaniya ham o'zgarishi kerak.
scenes.keywords: old and new technology side by side

description:
Nintendo 1889 yilda Kiotoda Fusajiro Yamauchi tomonidan hanafuda o'yin kartalari ishlab chiqaruvchi sifatida ochilgan. Video o'yinlarga u ancha keyin o'tdi: 1981 yilda Donkey Kong, 1983 yilda Famicom chiqdi.

Bu saboq sizga kerakmi? Izohda bitta so'z bilan yozing.
source: Fact-check 2026-11-12 (web search): all claims TRUE, no text change. Nintendo's own history page: founded 1889 (23 Sept) in Kyoto by Fusajiro Yamauchi to make hanafuda cards (original name Nintendo Koppai); Donkey Kong arcade 1981 (Nintendo Japan timeline); Famicom released in Japan July 1983. Before video games it tried other businesses in the 1960s (taxis, instant rice, toys). Still headquartered in Kyoto and still sells hanafuda in Japan (supported by Deep Kyoto and playing-card collector sites; no official press release found, so treat that last line as the softest claim). Sources: https://www.nintendo.co.jp/en/corporate/en/history/index.html ; https://www.nintendo.com/en-gb/Corporate/Nintendo-History-625945.html ; https://www.techradar.com/news/nintendo-before-the-nes-a-history-of-play ; https://www.deepkyoto.com/nintendo-playing-cards/
